description.narrative: De avsedda resultaten av interventionen är att den institutionella kapaciteten hos Afghanistans oberoende valkommission (IEC) förbättras, att Afghanistan har en hållbar långsiktig strategi för väljarregistrering och den informativa uppsökande verksamheten med nyckel intressenter och väljarkåren förbättras. Inom ramen för detta bidrag stödde Sverige Afghanistans presidentval 2014.

The intended outcomes of the intervention are that the institutional capacity of the Independent Election Commission (IEC) of Afghanistan is improved, that Afghanistan has a sustainable longterm approach to voter registration, and that informational outreach with key stakeholders an the electorate is enhanced. Within this contribution, Sweden supported the Afghanistan Presidential elections in 2014.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: The intended outcomes of the intervention are that the institutional capacity of the Independent Election Commission (IEC) of Afghanistan is improved, that Afghanistan has a sustainable longterm approach to voter registration, and that informational outreach with key stakeholders an the electorate is enhanced. Within this contribution, Sweden supported the Afghanistan Presidential elections in 2014. One important example of the results is that IEC acknowledge the importance of gender in its strategic plan and introduced a gender unit. First foundations have been laid for the development of an electronic voters register. Female election staff and election observers were mobilized.
